orchestrator.objective: Runs the incident: sets the goal, briefs the specialists, brings their answers together, asks a person when a decision needs authority.

maintenance.objective: Finds out what is wrong with the aircraft and what it would take to fix it; hands the airworthiness decision to certifying staff.

ground.objective: Arranges the stand, stairs, buses, towing and the ground handler's tasks.

flightops.objective: Works out the knock-on effect on today's flights and crew, and finds options: swap, delay, cancel.

passenger.objective: Keeps passengers informed and looked after; prepares messages, care and rebooking for approval.

record.objective: Keeps the timeline, decisions and evidence; drafts the reports that must be filed afterwards.

author.objective: Turns a description of what's happening into the scenario the team works on.
